name: Native item scaling scales laddered shirt items (#13397)
contract: #13397: NativeItemScaling::IsScalingItem gated on ItemScaling::LiftableEntry, which called EligibleItem and rejected INVTYPE_BODY (4, shirts) even when the shirt had a scaling ladder in ItemStat.dbc. Quest 258 (A Hunter's Challenge) rewards Fine Cloth Shirt 859 (INVTYPE_BODY, ItemLevel 12, laddered in ItemStat.dbc) as choice 0. In QuestTemplateScaling.dbc, quest 258 has MinLevel 17, MaxLevel 60, and highest threshold <= 39 at level 21 with offset -4, giving curve level clamp(39 - 4, 17, 60) = 35. Expected: a level 39 character with scaling on receives shirt 859 with stored scaling level 35 and can equip it, while a level 39 character with scaling off receives shirt 859 with scaling level 0.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: native item scaling assigns quest 258 curve level 35 to shirt 859
With scaling off, shirt 859 gets no scaling level
